title: Tensornetzwerke (TUM, Modul IN2388)
description:
- Fundamentals and graphical representation of tensor networks - Mathematical approximation theory - Backpropagation through tensor network operations - Simulating strongly correlated quantum systems and digital quantum computers - Probability distribution sampling using tensor networks

**Voraussetzungen / Prerequisites:**
• MA0901 Linear Algebra for Informatics • MA0902 Analysis for Informatics • IN0018 Discrete Probability Theory • Knowledge about quantum mechanics or computing helpful (but not a formal prerequisite)

goals.title: Lernergebnis
goals.description: After successful completion of this module, students are familiar with the mathematical formalism and graphical notation for tensor networks. They can assess and apply tensor network approaches for approximating high-dimensional data. They understand why tensor network methods are suitable for simulating strongly correlated quantum systems, and are familiar with corresponding algorithms.
